This 5-day trip gives you time to explore the Pantanal at an unhurried pace. It includes boat trips, horse riding, a 4x4 photographic safari, kayaking, piranha fishing and an extra day of safari activities at the lodge.

## The Pantanal up close

The itinerary gives you several chances to head out at different times of day and see the wetlands from different vantage points. From the water you get a clear view of the banks and the birds and animals that gather there. The horseback ride takes you along trails and across open plains. On the photographic safari, guides lead the group through marshes, grasslands and areas near the water.

You may see capybaras, caimans, herons, storks and kingfishers. Jaguars and giant otters are seen less often. Local guides accompany the outings and explain how the animals behave and how the wetland ecosystem works.

The Pantanal suits travellers interested in birdwatching, wildlife, photography, fishing and leisurely outings in nature. Lodges may also organise hikes and night outings to look for caimans.

Staying at the lodge is part of the experience. After an active outing, you return to a quiet spot surrounded by nature to rest, have lunch or dinner and get ready for the next excursion.

For photographers, the places where land meets water are especially rewarding. Capybaras may rest at the water’s edge, caimans may lie on the banks and birds often gather around channels and marshes. Near sunset, low light reflects off the water and picks out the silhouettes of animals and birds.

Horse riding, a 4x4 safari and kayaking offer three views of the same landscape. On horseback you can follow narrow trails and cross grassy plains. A vehicle covers a wider range of habitats, while a kayak lets you watch quiet stretches of water almost at surface level.

The extra full day of safari activities makes this a five-day itinerary. It leaves more time in the wetlands and for repeat outings, especially useful if wildlife watching or photography is your main reason for coming.
